color: rgb(28, 43, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 · WALK
.fuxignore first, then sources/dirs,
sources/urls, formats.toml include globs

div.style: color: rgb(28, 43, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 · DECODE
17 built-in decoders, copied into .fux/decoders/
consumer copy replaces by module name
decode(raw, rel_path) → str | None

div.style: color: rgb(58, 20, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
None → enrich/queue.tsv with a reason
(never silently dropped)

div.style: color: rgb(28, 43, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 · content_sha on the RAW bytes
(before redaction)

div.style: color: rgb(58, 20, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 · REDACT — pii.toml
body + frontmatter title, never the path
reaches the committed index only

div.style: color: rgb(28, 43, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5 · EXTRACT
title · heading phrases · terms (tf per field)
flen per field · analyzer v2 (split → lower → stop → Porter → blake2b-64)

div.style: color: rgb(28, 43, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6 · RESOLVE EDGES — every run
ref · tag · code · grades EXTRACTED 10 / AMBIG 8 / INFERRED 6

div.style: color: rgb(58, 20, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
meta: hashed for non-git sources (L5)
enforced inside write_index

div.style: color: rgb(58, 42, 8) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7 · WRITE
canonical JSON · sorted keys · NFC · no floats
shard = blake2b(id) → write-if-different

div.style: color: rgb(28, 43, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
carry-forward when sha, header, PII digest,
caps, enrichment sha, decoder VERSION unchanged
(edges never carried)
